html:
Question 2
?

Consider the finite region bounded by y=2−x and y=4−x2. Which of the following gives the volume of the solid generated when that region is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
π∫−12(x4−9x2+12)dx
b
π∫−10(x4−9x2+2)dx
c
π∫02(x4+4x+12)dx
d
π∫−12(x4−9x2+4x+12)dx
e
π∫−12(x4−4x2+12x−1)dx
Submit
